package.license_note: Upstream expression has three alternatives. CC0-1.0 is not an admitted license id and `Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception` is unsupported by the record syntax (policy section 2); this project relies on plain Apache-2.0 (spec 90 section 2.1).
package.notes: Features std and pure; default-features off, so no rayon, mmap, digest or zeroize. `pure` removes all C and assembly from the link: on x86-64 only the Rust SSE2/SSE4.1/AVX2 intrinsics modules are used (no AVX-512), on aarch64 the portable implementation (no NEON). build.rs still probes the C compiler for flag support through the already-locked `cc` crate, then builds nothing; a host without a C compiler also builds. No native build dependency is added. Trade-off: no AVX-512 and no NEON speed-up; revisit only with a benchmark and a new record.
